beforeSong.speaker: stickman
beforeSong.text: That line was never meant to move.

beforeSong.speaker: fracture
beforeSong.text: It is not a line. It is a door.

beforeSong.speaker: stickman
beforeSong.text: Then I will break the door with a song.

duringSong.speaker: fracture
duringSong.text: The beat is splitting. Hold the rhythm.

duringSong.speaker: stickman
duringSong.text: I hear the crack. I hear the fight.

beforeFinal.speaker: fracture
beforeFinal.text: I am not the enemy. I am the corruption inside the music.

afterSong.speaker: stickman
afterSong.text: The room falls quiet. The crack still hums.

afterSong.speaker: fracture
afterSong.text: It only sleeps until the next song begins.
